core_obligations: Shorten the duality sequence (proof lines 2621-2633): the Grauert-Riemenschneider vanishing identifies the derived pushforward of the dualizing module with its zeroth pushforward, so duality produces a short exact sequence from that pushforward to the dualizing module of the base with last term the second Ext of the first direct image of the structure sheaf.

Conclude the isomorphism (proof lines 2633-2638): the vanishing of the first cohomology of the structure sheaf, which is the defining property of a rational singularity, kills that last term, so the trace map is an isomorphism; the canonical map from the pullback of the dualizing module of the base follows.
proof_roadmap: Use the Grauert-Riemenschneider vanishing to shorten the duality sequence.
Apply the defining vanishing of a rational singularity to kill the last term.
Deduce the isomorphism and the canonical map from the pullback.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the rational situation with a dualizing complex on the base, the trace map from the global sections of the dualizing module of the resolution to the dualizing module of the base is an isomorphism, and consequently there is a canonical map from the pullback of the dualizing module of the base to the dualizing module of the resolution (statement lines 2617-2623). The proof (proof lines 2624-2638) combines the Grauert-Riemenschneider vanishing with the duality sequence and the defining vanishing of a rational singularity. H2: a complete short argument in two steps.
